parent.intent: Gradually increase the influence of the return-to-start edge as the tour progresses (early on nearest neighbor dominates; near the end closure matters more) to improve overall tour length, while retaining the regret term for tie-breaking among candidates with similar current distances.
parent.code:
def priority(f):
    d = f['distance']
    r = f['return_distance']
    g = f['regret']
    p = f['progress']
    return -d + (0.25 + 0.5 * p) * r + 0.15 * g
